summary: Steep residential kerb, 11% average, with homes 7-12 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings line this side: St Lucia Lodge 8 m, a detached home 12 m, Saccharo apartments 7 m, Maiano Lodge 22 m. No quiet spot.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along this kerb, so room to pull in, but the road falls steeply.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, through traffic to the north.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb all day, but resident-permit 2P signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.
